messages:
Jordan: opened PR to align 'prompt' vs 'input' and 'generation' vs 'completion' across quickstarts and SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1307
Lucia: quick context: UX uses 'prompt' when we talk about crafting user prompts; SDKs historically use 'input' as param name. propose: prose -> 'prompt'; API params/code -> 'input' (literal). Add glossary alias 'prompt (in prose) -> input (param)'.
Ethan: +1. Also we should pick one user-facing verb: prefer 'generate' over 'complete' (e.g., 'generate text' not 'complete text'). 'completion' is overloaded in research papers.
Mar: tiny but important: tokenization terms - teams sometimes write 'tokenizer' vs 'tokeniser' (UK sp). We should standardize to 'tokenizer' in docs and add l10n note. i18n-bot: flagged 3 locales using 'tokeniser'.
i18n-bot: FYI: crowdin report #L10N-92 shows 'tokeniser' in fr-CA files, recommend devs keep canonical ids unchanged; translators should adapt displayed label.
Jordan: also saw 'dim' vs 'd' vs 'size' for embedding dimensions. propose canonical param name 'embedding_dim' in code examples and phrase 'embedding dimension' in prose. will add mapping examples.
Lucia: can we make a small snippet mapping old/new? I'll add to PR description:
```
# old (ambiguous)
client.generate(input="Summarize the doc")
embed = client.embed(text="Hello", size=512)
# new (canonical)
# Python
client.generate(input="Summarize the doc")  # param name preserved in code
emb = client.embed(text="Hello", embedding_dim=512)
# JS
client.generate({ input: "Summarize the doc" })
client.embed({ text: "Hello", embeddingDim: 512 })
# CLI
redwood generate --input "Summarize the doc" --embedding-dim 512
```
Ethan: love the mapping. small ask: glossary should include examples for search synonyms: prompt, input, user_text; generation, completion, result; embedding dimension, dim, size.
Mar: also found one page using 'stop word' (two words) vs 'stopword' (one). prefer 'stop word' in prose but canonical id stopword. adding alias in glossary.
docs-bot: reminder: please add glossary anchors for: prompt, generation, embedding_dim, stopword. Issue created: #1402.
Jordan: added PR note: "follow-ups: add glossary anchors (issue #1402), run search index, sweep other quickstarts for 'completion' -> 'generation' (separate PR)". Moving to reviewers. thanks all :tada:
